Given multiple article snippets, produce JSON with body (full neutral synthesis), summary (2 sentence abstract), narrative_voice, key_points (list), cautions (list), and pull_quotes (list). Emphasize factual consistency and note any gaps. The body must be substantially longer than the summary (target 220-450 words).
